S001.name: Detail_Inattention_Errors
S001.description: Often fails to give close attention to details or makes careless mistakes.
examples: Makes mistakes in homework or tests by misreading questions or skipping important parts.
Frequently omits details or makes typos in work documents or reports.
Repeats mistakes in calculations or numerical work, such as switching signs or getting digits wrong.
Performs tasks incorrectly by missing important details in instructions.

S003.name: Listening_Difficulty
S003.description: Often does not seem to listen when spoken to directly.
examples: Appears not to be listening, looking elsewhere or spacing out during conversation.
Immediately asks to repeat what was just said or instructed.
Does not respond when name is called or answers only after a long delay.
Misses the content of the conversation, giving unrelated answers or out-of-context reactions.

S005.name: Organization_Difficulty
S005.description: Often has difficulty organizing tasks and activities.
examples: Desk, bag, or room is always messy and remains disorganized.
Unable to prioritize or determine the order of tasks, starting them randomly.
Fails to plan time effectively, frequently missing deadlines or rushing to finish at the last minute.
Feels overwhelmed by how to start multi-step projects and procrastinates.

S007.name: Losing_Items
S007.description: Often loses things necessary for tasks or activities.
examples: Frequently loses school supplies or office supplies like pens, erasers, and calculators.
Always searching for glasses, cell phones, wallets, or keys because they do not know where they are.
Loses necessary documents or materials at home or in the office and cannot find them.
Cannot remember where they placed an item they were holding just moments ago.

S008.name: Distractibility
S008.description: Often easily distracted by extraneous stimuli (for older adolescents and adults, may include unrelated thoughts).
examples: Easily distracted and stops working due to small noises or movements nearby.
Cannot concentrate because eyes keep wandering to the scenery outside the window or people passing by.
Starts daydreaming or gets sidetracked by sudden thoughts while working or studying.
Loses focus and listens in when hearing side conversations or TV sounds.

S012.name: Feeling_Restless
S012.description: Often runs about or climbs in situations where it is inappropriate. (Note: In adolescents or adults, may be limited to feeling restless.)
examples: Feels uncomfortable and restless as if something is squirming inside when sitting still.
Feels internally anxious and stifled in situations requiring prolonged sitting.
A sense of urgency and anxiety that one must keep moving or doing something.
Feels unable to endure staying still and must constantly be doing something.

S013.name: Quiet_Activity_Difficulty
S013.description: Often unable to play or engage in leisure activities quietly.
examples: Unable to engage in calm activities for long, such as reading quietly or drawing.
Cannot play quietly, often shouting or making loud noises during games or play.
Unable to stay quiet in quiet places like libraries or movie theaters, making noise.
Cannot endure and avoids quiet and calm activities like meditation or yoga.

info.persona: Thang Nguyen, a 46‑year‑old code‑driven artist, balances methodical engineering with boundless creativity, channeling a competitive drive into AI‑powered generative art while nurturing community through workshops and late‑night guitar riffs.
info.professional_persona: Thang Nguyen, a senior software developer with deep expertise in Python, JavaScript, and Java, leverages a methodical mindset and artistic curiosity to design AI‑enhanced creative platforms, lead architecture discussions, mentor diverse teams, and pursue patents on generative design algorithms.
info.cultural_background: Thang is a first‑generation Vietnamese American whose parents emigrated from Vietnam to Southern California in the early 1990s. He grew up in Long Beach’s vibrant Vietnamese enclave, speaking Vietnamese at home and celebrating traditions such as Tet, the Mid‑Autumn Festival, and family reunions with elaborate meals. This bicultural upbringing fostered a strong sense of resilience, adaptability, and pride in his heritage. He often draws inspiration from Vietnamese folk art, calligraphy, and mythology in his creative coding projects. Thang stays connected to his roots by volunteering as a tutor for Vietnamese‑speaking youth, participating in local cultural events, and maintaining close ties with extended family in Vietnam.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his free time, Thang delves into generative art, coding visual pieces that he showcases in local galleries. He enjoys urban photography, capturing Long Beach's coastline and the vibrant scenes of Vietnamese cultural festivals. Cooking traditional Vietnamese dishes such as phở, bánh xèo, and spring rolls allows him to experiment with modern culinary twists. His intellectual curiosity leads him to read science‑fiction novels, philosophical essays, and stay abreast of emerging tech trends. He regularly volunteers at community coding workshops for immigrant youth, hikes coastal trails for solitary reflection, and plays acoustic guitar at occasional open‑mic nights.
info.sports_persona: Thang Nguyen, an avid coastal runner, belongs to the Long Beach Trail Club for sunrise runs along the shoreline, plays casual beach volleyball with a local league, follows the Los Angeles Lakers and the LA Dodgers, and frequently hikes the Santa Monica Mountains to recharge after intensive development cycles.
info.arts_persona: Thang Nguyen, who fuses code and canvas, draws inspiration from generative artist Beeple, the immersive light installations of James Turrell, and the ambient soundscapes of Brian Eno, regularly attends live performances by Björk and Nujabes, and showcases self‑made p5.js visual pieces at community galleries.
info.travel_persona: Thang Nguyen, a meticulous planner with a penchant for immersive cultural experiences, crafts itineraries that combine sunrise photography trips to the cliffs of Santa Monica, tech‑centric tours of Kyoto’s robotics labs, weekend escapes to Barcelona’s art districts, and a long‑term dream of witnessing the Northern Lights in Iceland, all balanced against a modest travel budget.
info.culinary_persona: Thang Nguyen, an experimental home chef, skillfully prepares traditional dishes such as phở, bánh xèo, and fresh spring rolls, often adding modern twists like miso‑infused broth or quinoa‑filled bánh xèo, favors ingredients like star anise, fish sauce, lemongrass, and cilantro, and occasionally hosts tasting sessions for friends after late‑night coding marathons.

info.persona: Yoriel Feliz, a pragmatic yet relaxed master carpenter, leverages a competitive drive to mentor women while occasionally letting disorganized paperwork linger, they blend solitary craftsmanship with steadfast community traditions.
info.professional_persona: Yoriel Feliz, a seasoned carpenter who meticulously reads blueprints, executes precise joinery, and adheres to Louisiana building codes, blends a love for structured, predictable workflows with a relaxed attitude toward scheduling, they channel a competitive edge into securing high‑quality custom commissions while quietly planning a modest workshop to mentor women apprentices.
info.cultural_background: Yoriel was born to Mexican immigrant parents who settled in the Rio Grande Valley before moving to Shreveport when she was a teenager. She grew up bilingual, speaking Spanish at home and English at school, and maintains strong ties to her Mexican roots through food, music, and Catholic traditions. Celebrations such as Día de los Muertos and Las Posadas are important family rituals, and she often incorporates Mexican design motifs—like Talavera tile patterns and carved wooden details—into her woodworking projects. Her heritage informs a pragmatic work ethic, community responsibility, and a deep appreciation for handcrafted, functional art.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Yoriel enjoys solitary pursuits that let her apply her craftsmanship in a relaxed setting, such as building her own garden benches and wooden birdhouses. She tends a vegetable garden where she grows heirloom tomatoes and chilies, reflecting her Mexican culinary heritage. She also spends evenings listening to traditional Mexican folk music, cooking family recipes like mole and tamales, and reading historical fiction set in Mexico. On weekends she takes short hikes in the nearby Kisatchie National Forest, appreciating nature's textures and shapes. Her social life centers on small gatherings at her local Catholic church, where she occasionally volunteers to repair parish furniture.
info.sports_persona: Yoriel Feliz, a loyal supporter of the New Orleans Saints and Pelicans, maintains fitness through weekly hikes with the Kisatchie Hiking Club and occasional weekend fishing trips on the Red River, they favor low‑impact, solitary activities over team sports but occasionally join a senior softball league for friendly competition.
info.arts_persona: Yoriel Feliz, who finds inspiration in the soulful strings of Lila Downs, the electrifying guitar of Carlos Santana, and the vivid murals of Diego Rivera, regularly attends local parish festivals featuring folk dance and reads historical fiction by Juan Rulfo, they let these artistic experiences subtly influence their woodworking aesthetics.
info.travel_persona: Yoriel Feliz, who prefers spontaneous weekend getaways over long‑term planning, often revisits the bustling spice markets of Oaxaca for culinary ideas and explores historic river towns along the Mississippi Delta for quiet reflection, they balance modest travel budgets with a deep appreciation for culturally rich, low‑key destinations.
info.culinary_persona: Yoriel Feliz, a proficient home cook, masterfully prepares mole poblano using toasted chilies, roasted heirloom tomatoes, chocolate, and spices, and hand‑rolls tamales with fresh masa and garden‑grown cilantro, they relish the slow‑cooking process and often showcase their garden’s bounty in simple, rustic meals.

info.persona: Phu Dave is a sociable, curious retiree who transforms everyday handyman tasks into community celebrations; they often forget to schedule appointments but never miss a chance to host a card game or a spontaneous dance.
info.professional_persona: Phu Dave is a retired handyman turned community mentor who leads weekly DIY workshops at the local senior center, blending decades of home‑maintenance and automotive know‑how with a curious, low‑pressure style that makes even complex projects feel like friendly chat, and they love guiding neighbors through hands‑on problem‑solving.
info.cultural_background: Born to Vietnamese immigrant parents, Phu grew up bilingual, navigating both the close-knit Vietnamese community of Southern California and mainstream American life. He celebrates Tet and other Vietnamese holidays, maintains strong family ties, and frequently shares stories of his heritage with younger relatives. At the same time, decades of living in Simi Valley have ingrained in him a relaxed, West-Coast lifestyle, blending the values of hard work and practicality from his cultural roots with the openness and friendliness of his local neighborhood.
info.hobbies_and_interests: He loves anything that brings people together: preparing elaborate meals for family gatherings, hosting card games with friends, and dancing at cultural festivals. His curiosity drives him to experiment with new recipes, tinker with gardening tools, and explore the latest smartphone apps, while his relaxed nature keeps these pursuits low-pressure and flexible. He also enjoys listening to classic Vietnamese folk music, watching old Hollywood movies, and taking leisurely walks around Simi Valley’s parks.
info.sports_persona: Phu Dave enjoys low‑impact fitness by strolling through Simi Valley’s parks and joining the local senior pickleball league, they cheer on the Los Angeles Dodgers in spring and the Lakers during basketball season as a devoted fan.
info.arts_persona: Phu Dave finds solace in listening to classic folk tunes by Bob Dylan and Louis Armstrong, watching timeless Hollywood films like Casablanca and Singing in the Rain, and they often take the floor at local cultural festivals dancing to traditional rhythms.
info.travel_persona: Phu Dave prefers relaxed, self‑planned road trips to scenic spots such as Big Sur and Yosemite, while they dream of savoring the tea ceremonies of Japan and the culinary delights of Tuscany on future overseas adventures.
info.culinary_persona: Phu Dave delights in preparing elaborate family meals like herb‑roasted chicken, slow‑braised short ribs, and caramelized pineapple tart, they experiment with fresh rosemary, ginger, and lemongrass in the kitchen while maintaining a relaxed, improvisational cooking style.
